topic: 主谓一致核心规则与易错点 (Subject-Verb Agreement)
teaching_notes: 嗨，同学们！主谓一致就像是句子里的“最佳拍档”：主语如果是单数，后面的谓语动词通常要加 -s 或 -es（例如：The cat runs fast.）；如果主语是复数，动词就要保持原形（例如：The cats run fast.）。不过要注意几个超级“陷阱”：像 everyone, each, neither of 这样看似指多人的词，语法上其实都算作单数；而遇到 either...or...、neither...nor... 时，动词则要听从“离它最近的邻居”！牢记口诀：“单加s复用原，不定代词视作一，就近原则看邻居！”

questions.question: Everyone in our class ______ Ms. Green because she is always patient and kind.
questions.explanation: 不定代词 everyone 作主语时，谓语动词一律使用第三人称单数形式，因此选择 loves。

questions.question: Either the teacher or the students ______ going to decorate the main hall this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 由 either...or... 连接两个主语时，动词遵循“就近原则”。离谓语动词最近的主语是复数名词 the students，因此动词用 are。

questions.question: Neither of the two pens on the desk ______ properly; I need to find a pencil.
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数名词作主语时，中心词是 neither（两者中任何一个都不），在规范书面语中谓语动词视为单数，故用 writes。

questions.question: Bread and butter ______ my grandfather's favorite breakfast for over thirty years.
questions.explanation: bread and butter（涂黄油的面包）表示不可分割的单一食物概念，视作单数整体，因此系动词用 is。

questions.question: The captain, along with his crew members, ______ safely rescued from the stormy sea yesterday.
questions.explanation: 当主语后面有 along with, together with, as well as 等短语时，谓语动词的单复数完全取决于前面的核心主语 the captain（单数）。加上时间状语 yesterday，故用 was。

questions.question: There ______ a carton of milk and two fresh apples on the kitchen counter.
questions.explanation: There be 句型遵循就近原则。离 be 动词最近的主语是 a carton of milk（单数），因此谓语动词用 is。

questions.question: Ten kilometers ______ a long distance for a young child to run without stopping.
questions.explanation: 表示距离、时间、金钱等度量衡的复数短语（Ten kilometers）通常作为一个整体看待，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: The news about the upcoming school camping trip ______ extremely exciting.
questions.explanation: news（新闻/消息）是不可数名词，作主语时谓语动词用第三人称单数形式 sounds。

questions.question: A number of tourists ______ the ancient castle every weekend to take photos.
questions.explanation: “a number of + 复数名词”意为“许多……”，作主语时谓语动词用复数形式 visit。

questions.question: The number of students in our robotics club ______ from twenty to thirty-five this year.
questions.explanation: “the number of + 复数名词”意为“……的数量”，中心词是 number，谓语动词用单数，故用 has increased。

questions.question: Each of the five puppies ______ a tiny red collar with a silver bell.
questions.explanation: “each of + 复数名词”作主语时，重心在 each（每一个），谓语动词用第三人称单数形式 wears。

questions.question: Both Oliver and his elder brother ______ the school basketball team.
questions.explanation: both...and... 连接两个并列主语时，表示两者都，谓语动词必须用复数形式 support。

questions.question: Not only the students but also their science teacher ______ fascinated by the solar eclipse.
questions.explanation: not only...but also... 连接主语时遵循就近原则。离谓语最近的主语 their science teacher 是单数，故用 was。

questions.question: All the furniture in the new modern library ______ made of eco-friendly wood.
questions.explanation: furniture（家具）是不可数名词，无论前面加什么修饰词，谓语动词一律用单数 is。

questions.question: Our school football team ______ practicing hard on the playground right now.
questions.explanation: team 作为集体名词，在此处表示一个整体单位在训练，因此谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: Mathematics ______ always been Ethan's favorite subject since he was in Primary 1.
questions.explanation: Mathematics（数学）是以 -s 结尾的学科名词，属于单数不可数名词，谓语动词用 has。

questions.question: One of my best friends ______ in a quiet seaside town near Tokyo.
questions.explanation: “one of + 复数名词”结构中，主语的核心词是 One（其中一个），谓语动词用第三人称单数 lives。

questions.question: Fifty dollars ______ enough to purchase this illustrated science dictionary.
questions.explanation: 表示特定金额（Fifty dollars）作主语时，看作一个整体款项，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: Neither Maya nor her classmates ______ interested in playing video games during recess.
questions.explanation: neither...nor... 结构中，动词依据就近原则确定。最近的主语 her classmates 是复数，故选 are。

questions.question: Nobody in the art museum ______ allowed to touch the oil paintings.
questions.explanation: 不定代词 nobody 作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式 is。

questions.question: Running every morning and eating fresh fruit ______ us build a strong body.
questions.explanation: 两个动名词短语（Running... and eating...）由 and 连接，表示两件不同的事情，谓语动词用复数原形 help。

questions.question: Collecting rare stamps and postcards ______ a popular hobby among older generations.
questions.explanation: 句子的核心主语是动名词 collecting（集邮与明信片这一种爱好行为），单个动名词作主语谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: The police ______ looking for the owner of the lost golden retriever puppy.
questions.explanation: police（警察）是集合名词，形式上没有复数后缀，但在语法上永远看作复数，谓语动词用 are。

questions.question: A pair of running shoes ______ left behind on the sports field after school.
questions.explanation: 虽然 shoes 是复数，但主语中心词是 a pair of（一双），属于单数，故用 was。

questions.question: These craft scissors ______ too blunt to cut through the thick paper.
questions.explanation: scissors, glasses, trousers 等由两部分组成的物品名词，若没有 pair 修饰，作主语时谓语动词用复数 are。

questions.question: The school principal, as well as several grade-four teachers, ______ the meeting today.
questions.explanation: 主语后跟 as well as 短语时，谓语动词只与前面的真正主语 The school principal（单数）保持一致，故选 attends。

questions.question: There ______ several colorful balloons tied to the garden fence for the birthday party.
questions.explanation: There be 句型中后面的主语 several colorful balloons 为复数，根据语境和就近原则，过去时应用 were。

questions.question: Some of the apple juice ______ spilled onto the dining table cloth.
questions.explanation: some of + 名词作主语时，谓语动词依据名词的性质决定。apple juice 是不可数名词，所以用单数 has。

questions.question: Some of the chocolate cookies on the tray ______ already eaten by the children.
questions.explanation: some of 后接可数名词复数 cookies，谓语动词随之使用复数形式 were。

questions.question: Every boy and every girl in our primary choir ______ a certificate of achievement.
questions.explanation: 当 and 连接的两个单数名词前分别有 every, each 或 no 修饰时，全句谓语动词依然用单数，故用 receives。
